title: Python Notebook
summary: Python notebooks that run in the browser, with numpy, pandas, Matplotlib, seaborn, SciPy, SymPy, scikit-learn, Pillow, openpyxl, pyarrow and statsmodels. Code cells, Markdown with mathematics, input(), Stop and Restart, data files, .ipynb import and export, and saved work in this browser. Save HTML copy makes one file with Python, the packages, the notebook and its data, which runs offline from file:// in Chrome and Firefox. No code or data leaves the device. Pyodide 314.0.5 and PyScript 0.7.31, pinned.
